The OCR is badly damaged in one sentence of the fire passage (p. 99), and the consuming publication marks its reading there as a reconstruction from the French plus surviving English fragments; elsewhere only plain within-word scanner misreads were corrected and no wording was supplied. Title page carries the approbation of the Bishop of Montreal and the Marinette fundraising statement. Exact scan bytes not retained.

alternate_titles: The Finger of God Is There! or, Thrilling Episode of a Strange Event Related by an Eye-Witness
Le doigt de Dieu est la! ou Episode emouvant d'un evenement etrange raconte par un temoin oculaire
work.author: Peter (Pierre) Pernin, missionary priest
work.description: Pernin's memoir of the Peshtigo firestorm of the night of 8 October 1871, which he survived in the Peshtigo River, published at Montreal in 1874 in French and English with the approbation of the Bishop of Montreal and for the benefit of the Church of Our Lady of Lourdes at Marinette, Wisconsin. An Appendix, separate from the memoir proper, narrates the reported apparitions to Adele Brise at Robinsonville and the preservation of the chapel enclosure on the same night. The Appendix is the second earliest published narrative of the Champion events located by the consuming publication, and its only early witness to the 1871 preservation. Pernin declares his own abridgement, declines to call the preservation a miracle, and records that ecclesiastical authority had not yet spoken.
work.title: The Finger of God Is There! / Le doigt de Dieu est la!
